title: Theorem
body_md: There exists an $SO(3)\times\mathbb{Z}_2^T\times\mathbb{Z}_2^R$-invariant, normal matrix product state $\psi$ for any triple of indices $(\sigma_H,\sigma_T,\sigma_R)\in\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ with injectivity length $l\leq 8$.

title: Lemma
body_md:
Let $\sigma_H$ be the hidden-order index defined above for the MPS tensor associated to the spin $(\alpha,\beta)$ defining a normal MPS; then
\begin{equation}\sigma_H=(-1)^{2\alpha}=(-1)^{2\beta}\end{equation}
